title: Supervisor observation store and CLI verbs
action: New append-only store .bee/supervisor/observations.jsonl written ONLY through new verbs (CLI-only state law): `bee supervisor record` with --kind observation|silence (closed set, typed refusal otherwise), --signal <struggling-loop|big-decision|danger-op|none>, --note (one or two sentences), optional --target-session; and `bee supervisor list --json`. Record row: {ts, kind, signal, note, target_session, tick}. Follow an existing small verb group as the pattern (intent_group.rs is a clean single-file example); register in the dispatcher exactly as its siblings are. Regen is deferred to the wave barrier (orchestrator runs the full chain at wave close). Unit tests: a valid record appends one row; a bad --kind is a typed refusal that writes nothing; list reads rows back; the store directory is created on first write.

truths: bee supervisor record --kind silence --signal none --note X appends exactly one JSONL row
a bad --kind refuses typed and writes nothing
